cases.name: Florence Charleston
cases.caseStatus: COLD CASE UNSOLVED; FORENSIC INVESTIGATIVE GENETIC GENEALOGY ID'D HER
cases.narrative: On 10/26/1978, Officers with the Pershing County Sheriff’s Office responded to a report that human remains were found in Pershing County, Nevada approximately 13 miles west of Imlay near Scossa Road and located her remains inside of a garment bag buried in a shallow grave.
